newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver lifts near close, gold a shade down.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver lifts near close, gold a shade down.

text.p: Silver prices opened higher and lifted further towards the close on the back of industrial and festival buying on Tuesday, dealers said.
Silver was down by 15 rupees per kg on Monday.
"Supplies remained thin but importers are having large stock of silver on hand," one broker said.
"They may unload if prices go up further," he added.
"Gold on the other hand opened on a firm note following reports of the American attack on Iraq but sluggish physical demand capped early gains towards the close," one trader said.
Supplies were thin and sentiment was quiet.
